title: Howard Lutnick Took Softer Line on Nvidia as Calls for Tougher Controls Grew
summary_full: Critics say Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, and his department have shielded Nvidia as concerns have grown over A.I. chip sales to firms like Megaspeed.
